meta.name: talking-head-recut
meta.description: Package an existing talking-head / interview / podcast video with timed, designed GRAPHIC OVERLAY cards — kinetic titles, lower-thirds, data callouts, quotes, side panels, picture-in-picture — synced to the transcript, on a 16:9 / 9:16 / 4:5 canvas of your choice; the clip plays untouched underneath. Trigger on "graphic overlays", "on-screen graphics", "package / dress up my video". Not plain subtitles (/embedded-captions). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给视频添加动态图文叠加层，同步字幕与画面
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为访谈或播客视频添加专业图文卡片
copy.tagline_en: Add timed graphic overlays to videos, synced with transcript
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add professional graphic cards to interview or podcast videos

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会给已有的口播/访谈/播客视频叠加与说话内容同步的图文卡片（标题、底部信息条、数据、引用、画中画等），可指定 16:9、9:16 或 4:5 画幅，原视频原样播放，最终渲染成 MP4。转写在本机完成，无需第三方服务。
howto.when: 被「graphic overlays」「on-screen graphics」「package / dress up my video」触发，或要求给已有口播视频加图文卡片时。纯字幕/从零做视频除外。

say.text: 给这个访谈视频加上图文卡片，突出关键数据
say.note: Claude 会转写并生成带时间轴的卡片

say.text: 把我这段播客做成竖版，配上标题和引用条
say.note: 它会输出一个 9:16 的 MP4 成片

say.text: 给这段演讲视频设计底部信息条和侧边栏卡片
say.note: 样式和时长按转写内容自动安排

howto.what_en: Claude packages an existing talking-head/interview/podcast clip with timed graphic cards (titles, lower-thirds, data callouts, quotes, PiP) synced to the transcript, renders MP4, clip untouched. Aspect: 16:9/9:16/4:5. Local transcription.
howto.when_en: Triggered by "graphic overlays", "on-screen graphics", "package / dress up my video", or requests to package an existing clip with graphic cards. Not for plain subtitles or from-scratch videos.

say_en.text: Add graphic cards to this interview video, highlighting the key data.
say_en.note: Claude will transcribe it and generate a timed storyboard.

say_en.text: Turn this podcast into a vertical video, with titles and quote bars.
say_en.note: It renders a 9:16 MP4 with the original clip untouched.

say_en.text: Design lower-thirds and side-panel cards for this talk.
say_en.note: Timing and style are auto-chosen from the transcript.
